Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full find-care payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Care near you","subtitle":"Near Moscone Center · SoMa, San Francisco","facilities":[{"id":"f1","name":"GoHealth Urgent Care – SoMa","type":"urgent_care","distance":"0.3 mi","openNow":true,"hours":"Open until 8:00 PM","waitTime":"15 min wait","address":"876 Folsom St, San Francisco","phone":"+14155550142","services":["X-ray","Labs","Stitches"],"mapsUrl":"https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=876%20Folsom%20St%2C%20San%20Francisco%2C%20CA%2094107"},{"id":"f2","name":"Saint Francis Memorial Hospital ER","type":"er","distance":"1.5 mi","openNow":true,"hours":"Open 24 hours","address":"900 Hyde St, San Francisco","phone":"+14155550190","mapsUrl":"https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=900%20Hyde%20St%2C%20San%20Francisco%2C%20CA%2094109"}],"submitText":"Get directions"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading; defaults to 'Care near you'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title, e.g. 'Near Moscone Center · SoMa, San Francisco'.
- 'facilities' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the nearby places to get care. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection) and 'name' (string). Optional per facility: 'type' (string; one of 'urgent_care','er','primary_care','pharmacy','clinic','hospital','lab','telehealth' — drives the icon/hue; defaults to 'clinic'); 'distance' (string, e.g. '0.8 mi'); 'openNow' (boolean — shows a green Open / grey Closed pill); 'hours' (string, e.g. 'Open until 9:00 PM' or 'Open 24 hours'); 'waitTime' (string, e.g. '12 min wait'); 'address' (string); 'phone' (string, E.164 like '+14155550142' preferred — becomes a Call link); 'services' (array of short strings, shown as chips); 'mapsUrl' (string, a full https maps URL — becomes the Google Maps 'Directions' button; prefer the directions form 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=<url-encoded address>').
- 'submitText' (string, optional): unused label reserved for future; safe to omit.

Do NOT include any patient health information — this card is wayfinding only. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
